description_en: Bhajana Maṇḍala Phalcā is located to the south of Karuṇāmaya Mandira (BUN0001) in Bungmati. This Phalcā was established by either the Nijānanda or the Kṛṣṇa Praṇāmī sect of the Vaiṣṇava denomination of Hinduism. The president of the Bungmati branch of the sect Jñānabhakta collected donations from the locals to construct the Phalcā in 1995.After its construction, Kṛṣṇabhajanaswere performed regularly in the Phalcā. However, for some reason this stopped after a short while. In 1997, an organisation named Nijānanda Bhajana Maṇḍala was formed to organise chants on the first floor of the building. However, this also came to an end with the 2015 earthquakes. The Phalcā was badly damaged and was not rebuilt until 2019, where the Centre for Integrated Urban Development (CIUD) rebuilt the structure from scratch in 2019 using all new materials. None of the historical elements of the previous Phalcā were preserved or have been reused, and unfortunately no historic photos of the old Bhajana Maṇḍala Phalcā could be sourced. The new Phalcā features some unusual design elements such as a four column arrangement on the northwestern corner. The ground floor layout otherwise follows historic examples with the exception of the new railings and two gates. The upper floor appears out of proportion as the interior room height of 8 feet by far exceeds the traditional norm. The design and placement of the upper windows and door do not line up with the three-bay layout of the ground floor, and the balcony is a modern addition of little practical use. Small modern pantiles have been used to tile the roof. Nowadays, the ground floor is used by the Lāchi Bhajana Khalaḥ to perform Newaribhajanas,while music classes and chanting classes are held on the upper floor.
description_ne: काठमाडौं उपत्यकाका अन्य फल्चाहरूभन्दा यो फल्चा पृथक रहेको छ । पश्चिमाभिमुख गरी बनाइएको दुइ तलाको यो फल्चा निजानन्द सम्प्रदायद्वारा बनाइएको हो । वैष्णवहरूका अनेकौं सम्प्रदायमध्ये एउटा निजानन्द सम्प्रदाय हो । यस निजानन्द सम्प्रदायका भक्तहरु कट्टर शाकाहारी हुन्छन् र श्रीकृष्णलाई मात्र मान्दछन् । यस सम्प्रदायलाई कृष्ण प्रणामी पनि भनिन्छ । निजानन्द सम्प्रदायको बुंगमती शाखाको सभापति ज्ञानभक्तको अगुवाइमा चन्दा संकलन गरेर विसं २०११ सालमा यो फल्चा बनाइएको थियो । फल्चा बनाउँदा हेरा ज्यापुनीले कामदारहरूलाई खाजा खुवाएकी थिइन् । फल्चा बनाएपछि यहाँ कृष्ण प्रणामीको भजन गरिन्थ्यो । तर केही वर्षपछि कृष्ण प्रणामीको भजनमा शिथिलता आउन थाल्यो र पछि बन्दै भयो । विसं २०५४ मा निजानन्द भजन मण्डल गठन गरी फल्चाको पहिलो तलामा पुनः भजन संचालन गरियो । तर यो पनि धेरै वर्ष चलेन र बन्द भयो । विसं २०७२ सालको भूकम्पले यो फल्चालाई नराम्रो क्षति पुगेको थियो । फल्चा नभत्के पनि बस्नै नहुने गरी चर्किएको थियो । विसं २०७६ सालमा Centre for Integrated Urban Development (CIUD) नामको संस्थाले यो फल्चाको पुनर्निर्माण गरिदिएको थियो । अहिले फल्चाको भुइँतलामा लाछि भजन खलः नामको संस्थाबाट नेवारी भजन भइरहेको छ भने पहिलो तलामा भजन गाउने र वाद्यवादनको प्रशिक्षणका साथै अभ्यास गरिन्छ ।

historical_events.event_description: Jñānabhakta, the president of the Bungmati branch of the Kṛṣṇa Praṇāmī sect of the Vaiṣṇava denomination collected donations from the locals to construct the Phalcā. Herā Jyāpunī gave snacks to the workers during the construction period.
The Nijānanda Bhajana Maṇḍala group was formed and began to organise chanting sessions on the ground floor of the building.
The Phalcā was severely damaged by the 2015 earthquakes.

The Centre for Integrated Urban Development (CIUD) rebuilt the Phalcā from the ground up using entirely new materials. After the reconstruction, the Gaṇeśa Mandira (BUN0021) and this Phalcā were both inaugurated simultaneously.
